text: Every finite-dimensional Lie algebra over $\mathbb{R}$ is the Lie algebra of a unique simply connected Lie group.
explanation: True: this is the fundamental theorem of Lie theory, an equivalence of categories between simply connected Lie groups and finite-dimensional real Lie algebras. Each such algebra integrates to exactly one simply connected group; other groups with the same algebra arise as its quotients by discrete central subgroups.
